topic: iOS early field shape and touch audio hotfix
currentUserGoal: Fix the iOS screenshot issue where the first expanded field could render as a tall one-column strip, and restore the crunchy grass touch sound on mobile.
changesMade: Changed first field expansion from one random organic runner into a compact 2x2 first-spread cluster.
Added save migration normalization for early 1x3 or 1x4 fields so existing affected mobile saves load as a compact 2x2/near-square field.
Moved GameScene board tap handling so grass touch SFX gets the iOS gesture before music starts.
Raised the grass touch transient gain from 0.76 to 0.84 for better phone-speaker crunch.
verification: Headless Chrome/CDP smoke at 390x844 with a seeded bad 1x4 save: Continue into game rendered a compact 2x2 board.
Headless Chrome/CDP smoke at 390x844 with a seeded 7-touch single-tile save: one tile tap triggered First Sprouts and rendered a compact 2x2 board.
currentGitStatus: Modified hotfix files are expected before commit.
